name: dsh-bash-native

one_liner.zh: Windows DSH 原生 Bash 执行器与终端
one_liner.en: Native Windows Bash executor and terminal for DSH

local: 仅支持 Windows x64 引擎；需要 DSH 与 Node.js >=22.12.0。
可选终端组件依赖宿主提供的 DSH terminal packages。

readme_mismatch: README.md reports DSH compatibility >=0.2.0-rc.2, while package.json engines.dsh declares >=0.1.7-rc.2; the published compatibility statements differ.

completeness.reason: Executor, two registered presets, engine/toolchain resolution, sandbox integration, and optional terminal composition are implemented; this review did not read every supporting module.

code.reason: Typed modules separate engine resolution, argv, toolchain, presets, and terminal mounting; executor records sandbox facts per process.

docs.reason: Bilingual README covers installation, presets, terminal, configuration, toolchain, limitations, and cleanup.

maintenance.reason: The snapshot lists 14 commits and a push on 2026-11-04, three days before analysis.

tests.reason: The repository has 221 test files counted by extraction and CI runs the suite on Windows plus a Linux oracle.

quality.notes: Review is against the fixed commit; CI and test counts come from static repository metadata.
